subject: HealthSpark - mid-cycle uplift and co-term options
content:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@healthspark.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle uplift inquiry + co-term ask

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well — we’re forecasting higher usage for Q3 and are evaluating a mid-cycle uplift to avoid hit-or-miss throttling. Two asks from our side: 1) can you outline uplift pricing for an additional 600k tokens/month for the next 8 months, and 2) we’d like to align that additional capacity with our existing renewal on 2028-01-15 (co-term).

Procurement wants a rough invoice/timing plan and whether a partial credit or runway credit can be applied so we don’t pay full list this quarter. I’ve cc’d procurement@healthspark.com and Mark Li (finance).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Product Ops
HealthSpark

———

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@healthspark.com>
Cc: procurement@healthspark.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle uplift inquiry + co-term ask

Hi Elena — thanks for the note. Great problem to have. I put together two pragmatic paths (attached worksheet + quick summary below):

Option A — Temporary Top-up (fast):
- Add 600k tokens/mo for 8 months at our mid-size top-up rate (list: $0.0022/token, customer rate with annualized uplift: $0.0019/token).
- No change to contract end date; invoices issued monthly.
- Runway credit: we can provide a 20% runway credit applied to the first two invoices to smooth cash impact.

Option B — Bridge + Co-term (preferred for accounting):
- Add capacity as an amendment that annualizes the uplift and co-terms to 2028-01-15.
- Effective per-token rate drops to $0.0017 after annualization and commitment of the 8-month uplift as an early portion of next year’s commit.
- One consolidated invoice at amendment signing, or monthly invoicing if you prefer cashflow smoothing.

I’ve attached a worksheet showing sample economics for both options and a two-page timing checklist (Redwood_CoTerm_Timing_Steps.pdf).

Two quick questions for internal alignment:
1) Is HealthSpark planning any territory/region shifts that would change routing?
2) Is Mark OK with a single amended invoice vs. monthly split? Either works from our side but impacts billing.

If you want, Aditya and I can join procurement’s call tomorrow to walk through the worksheet.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: HealthSpark_Pricing_Worksheet_v1.xlsx
Attachment: Redwood_CoTerm_Timing_Steps.pdf

———

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@healthspark.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthspark.com; Mark Li <mark.li@healthspark.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle uplift inquiry + co-term ask

Thanks, Karthik — the worksheet is helpful. Procurement has two constraints: 1) they prefer spread invoices to preserve monthly burn caps, and 2) any price concession needs finance approval. Mark — can you confirm whether a 20% runway credit on the first two invoices is acceptable or if you’d prefer a lower percentage and contract amendment?

Procurement: our ideal is Option B (co-term) but we cannot process a large one-time charge to the 2027 P&L. Split invoicing + amendment seems necessary. Can Redwood issue an amended schedule that annualizes the uplift but allows monthly invoicing? That would check both boxes.

Elena

———

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@healthspark.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@healthspark.com, Mark Li <mark.li@healthspark.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:00:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle uplift inquiry + co-term ask

Looping in Aditya (sales lead) and Laura (rev ops) to confirm approval path for a split-invoice co-term amendment. Laura — we’d like to offer:
- Co-term amendment that annualizes the uplift to reduce per-token rate (to $0.0017)
- Monthly invoicing across the 8 months to satisfy HealthSpark procurement
- Runway smoothing: 15% credit applied across months 1–2 (Aditya indicated we can be flexible)

Aditya — can you confirm margin / discount guardrails for a customer at this scale? We’re looking for approval of a 15% applied runway smoothing plus co-term annualization.

Next steps: if approved, I’ll produce a Draft_Amendment_v3.docx and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik

———

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@healthspark.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@healthspark.com, Mark Li <mark.li@healthspark.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 11:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle uplift inquiry + co-term ask

Thanks for the context, all. Approve the proposed approach with one adjustment: commit to 12 months of annualized capacity (effectively pushing some of the uplift into next year) to preserve unit economics. We’ll extend the annualization window to 12 months and preserve the $0.0017/token rate on the annualized portion.

We can do the 15% runway smoothing across invoices 1–2 as requested. Laura — please prepare the amendment reflecting 12-month annualization and monthly invoicing.

Aditya Rao
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

———

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@healthspark.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@healthspark.com, Mark Li <mark.li@healthspark.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle uplift inquiry + co-term ask

Appreciate the quick turnaround. HealthSpark approves the amendment language and the economics as proposed (12-month annualization, monthly invoicing, 15% runway smoothing on invoices 1–2). Procurement will issue a PO this afternoon and requests DocuSign link for the amendment so we can expedite. Our PO number is HSK-PO-00754.

Can you route the DocuSign to procurement@healthspark.com and mark.li@healthspark.com? Once signed, we’ll confirm the first invoice payment schedule.

Thanks everyone — Elena
